title: Command the Terminal
prompt:
Match each task to its command — write your answers as a single object assigned to `answers`:

answers = { where: "?", list: "?", enter: "?", up: "?", makeFolder: "?" }

- where: show the current directory
- list: list the files here
- enter: move into a folder called my-project
- up: move back up one level
- makeFolder: create a folder called notes

tests.name: the five core commands
tests.hint: pwd · ls · cd my-project · cd .. · mkdir notes
